notices.title: Restricted take-out: fishing, hunting or wildlife viewing only
notices.text: At Yampa River SWA, launching or taking out a boat is allowed only while actively fishing, hunting or wildlife viewing. A general recreation-only float cannot use this take-out. Visitors 16 or older also need a valid hunting/fishing license or SWA pass. Follow posted restrictions.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Colorado Parks and Wildlife — Yampa River State Wildlife Area Boat Ramp
takeOutAccess.note: CPW identifies a developed ramp and its facility GIS point 2501 matches the access road at the river in imagery. Current Chapter W-9, effective September 1, 2026, section 901(286), allows vessel launching/taking out only for active fishing, hunting or wildlife viewing. Section 900(C)(1) requires a license or SWA pass from age 16, correcting the park page’s older age-18 wording. This is restricted access, not permission for a general recreation-only float. Retain approximate shoreline precision.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Dorsey access south of US 40 between Hayden and Craig. Launch or take out only while actively fishing, hunting or wildlife viewing. Visitors 16 or older need a valid hunting/fishing license or SWA pass. Parking is small; check posted restrictions before setting your shuttle.
